notes.title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 Demo and Store Page Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34547315/154ed3fab20fcd52f8fc3a2aea8c32066b8c3185.png[/img]The coming-soon page of The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 is now live!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128260/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart_2

The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 is planned to release on [b]November 8[/b]. Don't forget to wishlist the game to be notified when it launches!

[h1]Story and Features[/h1]
[i]Nora has been working at a beach hut with his friends. One summer's day, snow began to fall along the coastline.

And that... was how he met Iris, the Princess of Winter.[/i]

The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart 2 features 5 lovely new heroines, and you also get to spend more time with the 4 heroines of the first game - all brought to life by top voice actors. 

The full game has an estimated playtime of 35 to 45 hours, and contains over 100 gorgeous illustrations in full HD resolution!

[h1]Demo[/h1]
We've also released a playable demo that you can immediately download from the store page! It features a dual text option which lets you choose 2 languages out of English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese to display at the same time. We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Chinese Language Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/54ec3673b4b9d66056962d7e7c2ab926f048da71.jpg[/img]
We're happy to announce that The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart now supports both Traditional and Simplified Chinese in addition to English and Japanese!

With the built-in dual language feature you can use any mix of the 4 languages as you wish for the user interface, text and second sub text separately!

Moreover, the game's 3 DLC are now also in Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

notes.title: Trading Cards Are Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/a0e5460a91ff52414e09bd77d5945caf768097e4.png[/img]
Good news everyone! The trading cards for The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart are now live!

Simply play the game for a while to receive yours and craft cute emoticons and profile backgrounds with the colorful cast of the game!

notes.title: The Princess, the Stay Cat, and Matters of the Heart Anime on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/1a540614669568dc7c111d3f65b8047166fe3b25.jpg[/img]
Good news! The anime series for The Princess, the Stay Cat, and Matters of the Heart Anime is now also available for purchase on Steam!

Initially meant to be available upon launch, there was a system-side issue that delayed the release a few days, but the full anime is now available as a single 42-minute episode!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072810/

It can also be purchased alongside the game and all DLC via The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart - Stray Cat Bundle for an additional -15% discount.

notes.title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/0b4943820e967489a29af67f6fc0ce86c87f39e6.jpg[/img]
Can you save the world from annihilation... as a cat? Meet Particia, Princess of the Netherworld and the rest of the rowdy cast of The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart today! 

The game's available now with stellar full-HD art, top voice actresses bringing the charming heroines to life, and a dual language display that lets you view English and Japanese simultaneously if you wish.

You can enjoy a -20% launch discount until June 24!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/f6fdca399d289cbe6ee3b6017a34b8b25eade538.jpg[/img]

The Princess, the Stray Cat and Matters of the Heart (also known as "Nora to Oujo to Noraneko Heart") is one of Japane's most beloved recent visual novels, and had an anime adaptation in 2017.

[h1]Main heroine voices[/h1]
[list][*]Takamori Natsumi (Patricia)
[*]Sendai Eri (Kuroki Michi)
[*]Asakawa Yuu (Yuuri Shachi)
[*]Tanezaki Atsumi (Asuhara Yuuki)[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/75272b6058473bd1d7489e4d4b36eb24124b606b.jpg[/img]

A soundtrack, an gorgeous artbook and a vocal song album are also being made available alongside the game! You can find them as DLC on the store page, and purchase them even cheaper in a bundle!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/d930d7c6f430556d8988d0a22d1e46641191d732.jpg[/img]

Traditional and Simplified Chinese language support will also be added to the game soon.

Please enjoy the adventures of Nora and his friends!

notes.title: Demo Now Available, Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010600/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34547315/902cc8214986d71cfc2aeef23018a633708e0ef3.png[/img][/url]

A free demo is now available to play for The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart!

Just head on over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010600/The_Princess_the_Stray_Cat_and_Matters_of_the_Heart/]Store page[/url] to download it, and meet the charming cast of the game, brought to life by leading voice actors!

The beautiful full-HD game features a dual language option that lets you view either English or Japanese text, or both simultaneously.

Moreover, we're happy to share a release date for the game now: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart will release on [b]June 17[/b]. Please look forward to it!

We hope you'll enjoy the demo!
